en.hubeali:
Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban Bin Usman, from Misma’a, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The most superior of the charities is cooling the hot liver (quenching ones thirst)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from Misma’ who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
the best charity is cooling off a thirsty liver.”
